description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectDao class in the OrangeHRM system, which manages database operations related to projects, including CRUD operations, filtering, reporting, and related entity lookups within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for managing database operations related to Project entities, including CRUD, filtering, reporting, and admin access functionalities.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persist a Project entity to the database and return it.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Soft delete multiple projects by setting their 'deleted' flag.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieve a project by its ID if it is not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingProjectIds
methods.description: Return list of project IDs from provided list that exist and are not deleted.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieve a list of projects based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getProjectsCount
methods.description: Count of projects matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: isProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Check if a project name is already taken for a given customer, excluding a specific project if provided.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Determine if a given employee number has administrative rights on any project.

methods.name: getProjectIdList
methods.description: Get list of project IDs optionally including deleted.

methods.name: getProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Get list of project IDs to which a project admin employee has access.

methods.name: hasTimesheetItemsForProject
methods.description: Check if there are timesheet items associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieve report criteria for projects based on search filters.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Count of report criteria entries based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectReport
methods.description: Calculate total duration for project reports based on filters.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieve detailed report criteria for project activities.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Count of detailed report criteria for project activities.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculate total duration for detailed project activity reports.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Return employee numbers of employees accessible to a project admin.

methods.name: getUnselectableProjectIds
methods.description: Retrieve list of project IDs with no timesheet items (unselectable).

methods.name: getActivityIdsOfProjectInTimesheetItems
methods.description: Get activity IDs associated with a specific project's timesheet items.
